description: Generation-2 stores subjectivity as an ordinal label and the pipeline maps it onto the shared 1-5 rank. Python coerces at generation time, TypeScript renders the label back for display, so both sides read these cases.

declined.name: empty string is a declined score, not an error
whitespace only is a declined score

rejected.name: a v1 numeric score is not a v2 label
an unknown label must fail loudly
